name: Secure ATM Simulator
highlights: An ATM simulator that shows how a real cash machine keeps your money safe, built around an interactive 3D machine made in Spline and driven from React over a postMessage bridge.

Real cryptography from the Web Crypto API: ISO 9564 PIN blocks encrypted with AES-256-GCM, PBKDF2-SHA256 PIN checks in constant time, and ARQC-style HMAC cryptograms that reject replayed or altered transactions.
An attack lab stages skimming, brute-force, replay and insider log-tampering attacks, and shows each defence respond, including a SHA-256 hash-chained audit journal that exposes any edit.
A pure state-machine core with hold-before-debit money handling and exact bounded-knapsack note dispensing, covered by 44 unit tests.
